text:
Mia: heads up — PR #4821 has a small migration guide section for the Optimize toolkit but the KV-prefetch heuristics example is confusing. @Sanjay can you take a look? https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4821
Sanjay: saw it, thanks. the PR links a couple of old snippets (optkit/old-prefetch.md) that 404. I'll open a quick fix branch.
docs-bot: PR #4821 detected: migration guide + SDK examples (optimize). automated link check flagged 2 broken links.
Leo: quick note — the Go SDK snippet in that PR uses `Prefetch` camelCase, but our public examples and runtime expect `prefetch` snake_case. mismatch will confuse devs.
Mia: good catch. also the Python example sets `batch_size=64` which is huge for shortseq workloads — recommend 8–16 for short sequences.
Sanjay: agreed. I'll update both snippets: change naming, add a recommended batch_size table, and fix the 2 links. also adding a short paragraph on quant profiles: suggest `q4_0` for latency-sensitive, `q2_k_m` for memory-constrained (with note to validate on your eval set).
Anya: happy to run the snippets locally and capture smoke metrics. which sample corpus should I use?
Leo: use `demo-prompts/shortseq-10k.txt` from the examples folder. run: `./scripts/run_optkit_samples --file demo-prompts/shortseq-10k.txt --batch 16 --prefetch true`
Anya: running now — will paste perf and any stack traces here.
deploy-bot: CI triggered for branch `docs-fix/prefetch-4821` — status: queued.
Sanjay: pushed `docs-fix/prefetch-4821`. changes: updated Go + Python snippets, fixed link targets, added quant profile recommendations. PTAL.
Mia: can someone add a short 'When to use KV prefetch vs prefix cache' blurb? that's the part people stumble on.
Leo: suggested wording: "KV prefetch is best for workloads with repeating prefixes and high request parallelism; prefix caching is cheaper to warm when you have a few long-lived contexts or streaming sessions." short and actionable.
Anya: smoke test finished. no exceptions. quick sample output:
```
Request 0: tokens=128 latency=72ms
Request 1: tokens=64 latency=55ms
Approx throughput: 140 req/s at batch=16, prefetch=true
```
Anya: uploading logs to the PR now (artifact: smoke-shortseq-16-2026-03-23.log).
Mia: perfect. @Sanjay please add a migration checklist to the PR description: 1) update SDK snippets (go/python), 2) fix internal/external links, 3) add quant recommendations, 4) attach smoke logs, 5) add the KV vs prefix blurb.
Sanjay: adding the checklist now. ETA by EOD.
Mia: assigning followups: @Sanjay (PR patch + checklist), @Anya (upload smoke logs + perf summary), @Leo (review final wording). I'll do a final pass tomorrow AM and merge if green. :thumbsup:
